description: Get historical regime statistics for one crypto asset: episode counts, mean/median 7/14/30-day returns, hit rate, drawdown and episode-bootstrap confidence intervals. This is historical statistics, not a prediction or financial advice. Universe: current catalog assets (survivorship bias). Groups with fewer than 20 episodes are marked insufficient. Paid: $0.02 USDC per call via x402. Discover valid assets with list_assets.

asset.description: Asset id or symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, or regime-stats-btc. Use list_assets to discover supported values.

name: get_regime_stats
title: Get historical regime statistics for one asset
